import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class MaxFlowSolver {
    static final int MAXN = 202;
    static final int INF = 0x3f3f3f3f;
    static int[][] flow = new int[MAXN][MAXN];
    static int[][] cap = new int[MAXN][MAXN];
    static int[] pre = new int[MAXN];
    static int[] que = new int[MAXN];
    static int[] dist = new int[MAXN];

    static int maxFlow(int n, int s, int t) {
        int totalFlow = 0;
        while (true) {
            Arrays.fill(pre, -1);
            Arrays.fill(dist, 0);
            dist[s] = INF;
            int front = 0, rear = 0;
            que[rear++] = s;
            while (front < rear && pre[t] < 0) {
                int u = que[front++];
                for (int v = 0; v < n; v++) {
                    if (pre[v] < 0 && cap[u][v] - flow[u][v] > 0) {
                        pre[v] = u;
                        dist[v] = Math.min(dist[u], cap[u][v] - flow[u][v]);
                        que[rear++] = v;
                    }
                }
            }
            if (pre[t] < 0) break;
            for (int v = t; v != s; v = pre[v]) {
                flow[pre[v]][v] += dist[t];
                flow[v][pre[v]] -= dist[t];
            }
            totalFlow += dist[t];
        }
        return totalFlow;
    }

    static char[][] gridA = new char[11][11];
    static char[][] gridB = new char[11][11];
    static int bi, bj;
    static int[][] directions = {{0,1},{0,-1},{1,0},{-1,0}};
    static int[][] matrix = new int[101][101];
    static int size, timeLimit;
    static List<Integer> listA = new ArrayList<>();
    static List<Integer> listB = new ArrayList<>();
    static List<Integer> listC = new ArrayList<>();

    static void explore(int A, int B, int[] visited, boolean check) {
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        int p = A * size + B;
        visited[p] = 0;
        q.offer(new int[]{A, B});
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] current = q.poll();
            int ci = current[0], cj = current[1];
            int pIdx = ci * size + cj;
            int dis = visited[pIdx];
            if (check && (matrix[bi * size + bj][pIdx] <= dis || timeLimit <= dis)) {
                if (matrix[bi * size + bj][pIdx] < dis || timeLimit < dis) {
                    visited[pIdx] = INF + 1;
                }
                continue;
            }
            for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                int ni = ci + directions[d][0];
                int nj = cj + directions[d][1];
                if (ni < 0 || nj < 0 || ni >= size || nj >= size) continue;
                if (gridB[ni][nj] < '0' || gridB[ni][nj] > '9') continue;
                int qIdx = ni * size + nj;
                if (visited[qIdx] != INF) continue;
                visited[qIdx] = dis + 1;
                q.offer(new int[]{ni, nj});
            }
        }
    }

    static void setup() {
        for (int i = 0; i < size; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < size; j++) {
                if (gridB[i][j] < '0' || gridB[i][j] > '9') continue;
                listA.add(i);
                listB.add(j);
                int p = i * size + j;
                cap[p + 2 + size * size][1] = gridB[i][j] - '0';
            }
        }
        int z = bi * size + bj;
        for (int i = 0; i < size; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < size; j++) {
                if (gridA[i][j] < '0' || gridA[i][j] > '9') continue;
                int p = i * size + j;
                cap[0][p + 2] = gridA[i][j] - '0';
                for (int k = 0; k < listA.size(); ++k) {
                    int ii = listA.get(k), jj = listB.get(k), qIdx = ii * size + jj;
                    if (matrix[p][qIdx] < INF)
                        cap[p + 2][qIdx + 2 + size * size] = INF;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        int n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int t = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        size = n;
        for (int i = 0; i < 101; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(matrix[i], INF);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String line = br.readLine();
            gridA[i] = line.toCharArray();
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String line = br.readLine();
            gridB[i] = line.toCharArray();
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (gridA[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    bi = i;
                    bj = j;
                }
            }
        }
        int[] visited = new int[size * size];
        Arrays.fill(visited, INF);
        explore(bi, bj, visited, false);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (gridA[i][j] >= '1' && gridA[i][j] <= '9') {
                    int[] v = new int[size * size];
                    Arrays.fill(v, INF);
                    explore(i, j, v, true);
                    for (int k = 0; k < v.length; k++) {
                        matrix[i * size + j][k] = v[k];
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        setup();
        System.out.println(maxFlow(2 + size * size, 0, 1));
    }
}
